decisionRules.FAIL_CLOSED: A complete valid matrix misses a scientific gate. Close L1 only; do not retune or run L2/L3.
decisionRules.PASS: Every locked win, bootstrap, natural participation, paneBreaker reachability and zero-fault gate passes.
decisionRules.STOP: Any preflight, identity, scope, matrix, process or reliability assertion fails; no scientific result is claimed.

design.betweenSubjects: The same seed is a CRN variance-reduction block only. L0 and L1 are divergent trajectories and are never read as twins.

estimands.activationComplementarity: For each vow, Pr(resonantLancePlayed > 0)[PC] - Pr(...)[P] - Pr(...)[C] + Pr(...)[O].
estimands.paneBreakerReachability: Within L0, the distribution of total per-run shatters and the fraction with total shatters at least 15, per vow and pooled.
estimands.participation: Offered, Drawn, Played and final InDeck fields per row for resonantLance and quakeblow.
estimands.pooledWinComplementarity: Arithmetic mean of the Vow-0 and Vow-5 win complementarities.
estimands.winComplementarity: For each vow, Pr(win)[PC] - Pr(win)[P] - Pr(win)[C] + Pr(win)[O].

nonGoals: No content, relic, system, P9, #108, map or promotion change
No parameter rescue, retune, push, pull request or merge

requirements: exact pool delta at every tier

question: Does the current authored paneBreaker producer/consumer pair express a second Duskblade package without a new primitive?

reliability.additionalStalls: For each vow and policy cell, max(0, L1 stall count - L0 stall count), summed.

seedBands.ledger: Binding grammar-only protocol ledger; protected and reserve identities are never emitted.

statistics.bootstrapUnit: Sample 256 seed blocks with replacement; each block retains all arms, policies and vows. Compute cell means before PC-P-C+O; no per-row causal twin effect is formed.
statistics.interval: Two-sided 95% percentile interval using sorted indices floor(0.025B) and ceil(0.975B)-1.

thresholds.naturalActivationRule: At each vow, at least 5% of the 512 L1 rows have resonantLancePlayed > 0.
thresholds.paneBreakerReachabilityRule: At each vow, at least 5% of the 512 L0 rows have total shatters >= 15.
